suite.resultNote: This file maps requirements to discoverable test titles. It deliberately does not manufacture or cache an execution result; CI or a retained Playwright report is authoritative for a particular commit.

fixtureSemantics.fileSystemAccess: The application uses its production DirectoryWorkspaceAdapter and document-session stack. The fixture supplies byte-backed picker handles because Playwright cannot operate Chromium's native folder chooser.
fixtureSemantics.opfs: The OPFS case uses Chromium's real navigator.storage.getDirectory() on a loopback origin and the exact built dist/index.html.
fixtureSemantics.persistence: Fixture bytes, permissions, picker behavior, write failures, and write logs persist through localStorage so reload and cross-tab cases share backing state.
limitations: The fixture is not a native operating-system directory picker.
The suite is listed only for Chromium here; final Firefox and WebKit release evidence remains a separate gate.
The 100 MiB aggregate history cap is covered below by lower-level automated tests, while this browser suite exercises the default 21-to-20 per-process retention boundary.

requirements.requirement: Reload recovery for dirty directory, OPFS, and single-file documents.
browserTests: mandatory recovery: real OPFS restores a dirty draft after reload
mandatory recovery: single-file upload restores a dirty draft after reload
mandatory recovery: directory/FSA workspace restores a dirty draft after reload
requirements.coverageNote: Exercises production draft journaling and recovery review for all three storage modes; OPFS is real browser storage.

browserTests: mandatory path transactions: dirty rename, move, and delete honor every gate
requirements.coverageNote: Exercises Cancel, Continue without saving, and Save and continue through production dialogs and verifies persisted paths/bytes.

requirements.requirement: Ctrl/Cmd+S with multiple mounted tabs saves only the active file.
browserTests: mandatory save: Ctrl+S saves only the active dirty tab
requirements.coverageNote: Verifies fixture write logs and persisted bytes for active and inactive tabs.

requirements.requirement: External edit conflict and all conflict choices.
browserTests: mandatory conflicts: compare, keep, reload, overwrite, and save-as preserve intent
requirements.coverageNote: Exercises Compare, Keep editing, Reload disk version, Overwrite disk version, and Save as a new file.

requirements.requirement: Workspace switch during assistant, interview, and generation.
browserTests: mandatory workspace switch aborts in-flight generation, assistant, and interview work
requirements.coverageNote: Holds real production fetch paths, switches workspaces through the UI, releases late requests, and verifies that no stale result crosses the workspace boundary.

browserTests: mandatory workspace switch and picker cancellation retain the current dirty workspace
requirements.coverageNote: Injects a standards-shaped AbortError at the picker boundary and verifies the existing workspace remains selected.

browserTests: mandatory isolation: unreadable entries do not block good files and permission loss retains dirty XML
requirements.coverageNote: Verifies a readable process remains usable beside an unreadable entry and denied write permission retains the dirty editor without changing storage.

browserTests: mandatory coordination: simultaneous cross-tab saves never silently overwrite both drafts
requirements.coverageNote: Runs simultaneous production saves against shared backing bytes and requires one winner plus visible collision evidence and a retained dirty draft.

browserTests: mandatory recovery history restores a revision and quota failure keeps the live draft
mandatory recovery history retains the newest 20 revisions and prunes the oldest first
requirements.coverageNote: The browser tests restore through the production dialog, inject a QuotaExceededError while proving the live draft remains dirty, and perform 21 UI saves to verify 20 newest revisions and paired persisted records. The 100 MiB aggregate cap remains a lower-level automated boundary.

browserTests: mandatory index integrity repairs duplicate IDs and projects unsaved XML into search, catalog, and links
requirements.coverageNote: Opens the duplicate selected by the diagnosis, repairs it through the production action, explicitly saves it, and condition-polls the actual persisted BPMN bytes until the two process IDs differ.

requirements.requirement: Live dirty search, catalog, and link updates.
browserTests: mandatory index integrity repairs duplicate IDs and projects unsaved XML into search, catalog, and links
requirements.coverageNote: The browser case starts with a resolved called-process hierarchy, changes the caller name and calledElement in a dirty production editor, then proves immediate search and catalog projection, resolved-link detachment, unresolved-target UI, and unchanged durable bytes.
